name: Telnyx
description: Telnyx SMS/MMS messaging, messaging profiles, Programmable Voice, Conferences, Recordings, Call Control Applications, Queues, and Phone Numbers API. Use it to search and order EU numbers, build IVRs, control live calls, stream media to AI agents, record calls, and add supervisors for monitor/whisper/barge workflows.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Telnyx API key with the Messaging, Voice and Numbers permissions required by the tools you use.

credential_fields.name: connection_id
credential_fields.label: Default Call Control Application ID
credential_fields.description: Optional default Telnyx Call Control Application / connection ID to copy into call tools.

credential_fields.name: public_key
credential_fields.label: Webhook Public Key
credential_fields.description: Optional Telnyx Ed25519 public key from Mission Control Portal > Keys & Credentials > Public Key. Add it only when receiving webhooks so Apteva can verify their signatures; REST API access requires only the API key.

credential_fields.name: phone_number
credential_fields.label: Default From Number
credential_fields.description: Optional default Telnyx phone number to call from, in E.164 format.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send SMS or MMS from a Telnyx-owned number through its messaging profile. Text is a string, preserving verification-code leading zeros. Set type=MMS for media_urls. Use webhook_url for delivery updates or use_profile_webhooks to use profile callbacks.

tools.name: get_messaging_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the webhook and messaging settings of a profile owned by this Telnyx account.

tools.name: create_messaging_profile
tools.description: Create a messaging profile. Supply explicit permitted destination countries and webhook configuration. Does not modify voice routing.

tools.name: update_messaging_profile
tools.description: Patch only specified messaging-profile fields. The webhook change affects all numbers sharing the profile; inspect profile membership first. Does not change voice settings.

tools.name: list_messaging_profile_phone_numbers

tools.name: search_available_phone_numbers
tools.description: Search Telnyx inventory for numbers that can be ordered. Use filter[country_code]=FR or ES and filter[phone_number_type]=local/national/mobile/toll_free where available.

filter[country_code].description: ISO country code, e.g. FR or ES.

filter[features].description: Features such as voice, sms, mms where supported.

filter[national_destination_code].description: Area/prefix code, e.g. 1 for Paris or 91 for Madrid where supported.

incoming_call.description: A caller dials a provisioned number. On a number assigned to a Call Control application, creates a parked call and delivers call.initiated to the application. On a number assigned to an FQDN connection (direct SIP), sends no Call Control webhooks: creates a sip_calls record and hands sip_inbound_call to the app that owns the simulated connection, which places the SIP call itself and reports its progress into the record; the result carries sip_call_id.

caller_audio.description: Caller audio: a caller audio fixture (default caller-speech-8k.wav) or silence. Played into the media stream of a Call Control call; inlined into the hand-off of a direct SIP call.

steps.detail: {{input.to}} is not assigned to a connection
{{audio}} is not a caller audio fixture
{{input.to}} is assigned to {{number.connection_id}}, which is not a Call Control application

caller_hangup.description: The caller hangs up. Delivers call.hangup with hangup_source caller, then call.recording.saved for a recording in progress, and stops the call's media stream.

callee_answer.description: The callee of an outbound call (dial_call) answers. Delivers call.answered, starts a record-from-answer recording, starts caller audio on the call's media stream, and delivers the answering machine detection result when dial_call asked for one.

answered_by.description: Detection result: human (default), machine or not_sure; premium detection also takes human_residence, human_business, silence and fax_detected (default human_residence).

audio.description: Caller audio the callee speaks once media starts: a caller audio fixture (default caller-speech-8k.wav) or silence.

steps.detail: call is a {{call.direction}} call in state {{call.state}}, not an outbound call that is ringing

callee_no_answer.description: Nobody answers an outbound call before it times out. Delivers call.hangup with hangup_cause timeout and stops the call's media stream.

steps.detail: call is a {{call.direction}} call in state {{call.state}}, not an outbound call that is ringing

callee_fail.description: An outbound call fails before it is answered: busy by default, or any Telnyx hangup cause such as call_rejected or unallocated_number. Delivers call.hangup and stops the call's media stream.

sip_hangup_cause.description: SIP status; defaults to 486 for user_busy, otherwise unspecified.

callee_hangup.description: The callee of an answered outbound call hangs up. Delivers call.hangup with hangup_source callee, then call.recording.saved for a recording in progress, and stops the call's media stream.

caller_speaks.description: The remote party of a call speaks: queues a caller audio fixture on the call's media stream after any audio still playing.

audio.description: Caller audio fixture; defaults to the stream's caller audio (caller-speech-8k.wav unless the call chose another).
